decisions.reason: The revised launch time does not change the required digital deliverable or its two-page-spread display behavior; scheduling remains owned by the separate launch-deadline Requirement.
The deadline extension does not change the article-ending standard, current balance method, or next-issue prevention method.
Changing the launch time does not alter the requirement to enhance publication images when needed.
The revised launch deadline does not alter author-name, author-photo, sizing, shape, coverage, or source requirements.
The advertisement clarity requirement remains valid and unchanged despite the revised launch time.
The launch-time change does not alter the table-of-contents accuracy criterion or its dependence on finalized pagination.
The source changes only the launch deadline and does not modify the treatment of long article text or permitted text-break elements.
The revised launch time does not select a platform or change the free-hosting requirement.
The deadline change does not modify the flat-plan basis, article placement, tribute placement, or editorial ordering rules.
The revised launch time does not change the magazine's visual style, branding reference, or color-use constraints.
The deadline extension does not alter the selected Inter typeface, weight treatment, or readability requirement.
